q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.ruled_out_libjavacore: deployed libjavacore.so carries the GENUINE AOSP Linux_statvfs JNI (_ZL13Linux_statvfs...) and imports U statvfs/U fstatvfs from musl, building android.system.StructStatVfs. StatFs/Os.statvfs/File.getUsableSpace WORK on route-A; never on this code path.
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.ruled_out_sandbox_statvfs: getCacheQuotaBytes is a binder quota query, not a statvfs syscall; the sandbox mount is never consulted on this path.
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.root_cause: JAR / system-service shim: bms/src/adapter/framework/activity/java/StorageManagerProjectionProxy.java installs a child-local MountBinder for ServiceManager 'mount' (IStorageManager) that implements ONLY INTERFACE_TRANSACTION + TRANSACTION_GET_VOLUME_LIST(0x1e). getCacheQuotaBytes falls through to super.onTransact (unknown code) -> empty reply -> Proxy.readException() reads 0 (NO throw) + readLong() returns 0 -> getCacheQuotaBytes returns 0 cleanly. Matches hilog (a 0, no RemoteException).
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.why_getUuidForPath_ok: getUuidForPath only needs getVolumeList(0x1e, implemented) and returns UUID_DEFAULT for an internal path.
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.why_app_still_lit: the bridge swallows Application.onCreate exceptions (logs [B43-BIND] ensureBindApplication FAILED, then launches the Activity). UI lit; functional cost = coil disk image cache disabled.
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.pre_predicted: benchmark/2026-09-24-batch4-blind/maps/libretube/gap-map.json already flagged 'StorageManager: 1 of 1 natives unregistered ... needs binder 'mount' (SystemServiceRegistry.java:709) ... app calls getCacheQuotaBytes, getUuidForPath'.
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.minimal_fix: extend StorageManagerProjectionProxy.MountBinder.onTransact to answer TRANSACTION_getCacheQuotaBytes (and siblings getAllocatableBytes, getCacheBytes), resolving the transaction codes via reflection on IStorageManager.Stub (same reflection-friendly style as the hard-coded 0x1e). On those codes: enforceInterface, read uuid(+uid), reply.writeNoException(); reply.writeLong(quota) where quota = Math.max(new StatFs(dataDir).getAvailableBytes()/8, 64MB) using the GENUINE StatFs. Single file, child-local, no native, no new service. Rollback = delete the added case.
q3_root_cause_fix_prediction.fix_properties: every returned quota is > 0 so the app's require() never trips; value derived from real free space (honest), not a magic constant; projection grows by exactly the transactions apps call (gate pattern preserved).

prediction.with_fix: LibreTube onCreate completes; coil disk cache enabled; the swallowed ensureBindApplication FAILED disappears; UI unchanged (already lit).
prediction.blast_radius: narrow: specific to the getCacheQuotaBytes/getAllocatableBytes -> size idiom. coil-default (maxSizePercent, sizes off StatFs free space which WORKS) apps are UNAFFECTED. In scope the symptom is a single key (fd-libretube).

rule: Read the decompiled call site before naming the failing API: 'cache size 0 / size must be > 0' is not necessarily StatFs. Here it is StorageManager.getCacheQuotaBytes (an incomplete 'mount' binder projection), while the libc statvfs path is genuinely present. Fix the smallest missing layer (one more mount transaction), derive the value from the real free space that already works, keep > 0 guaranteed.
